name: Netted

requirements: Editorial curation only — Netted is the Webbys team's hand-picked app/site newsletter; no submission form
Products covered: 'the best sites, apps, and connected products' — consumer-facing tools with a delight factor
Contact route: the 'Contact us' page; advertising is separate
preparation: A genuinely delightful consumer product — Netted's taste runs to clever/beautiful/useful
A pitch via the contact page
workflow: Pitch the editorial team via netted.net/contact-us
Coverage is a newsletter feature/short review — no profile page
watchFor: Low cadence — newest content observed was months old; the newsletter may be semi-dormant
Single-editor curation — acceptance is taste-driven and rare
countsAsLive: A Netted newsletter feature or article mentioning the product
unknowns: Whether the newsletter still publishes regularly
